dialogue.text:
(Greeting you as though he had been
expecting you to find this place.)

yes.text: (He asks if you are proud of yourself.)

(He tells you that, in the end, everyone is drawn back to the place where they
belong.)

(A place where they are most
comfortable.)

(Reminding you that this place once
brought you pain.)

(The man put his hand softly on your
shoulder.)
(He put his finger to his chest, smiled, and nodded his head.)

(He tells you that sometimes the greatest
moments can only be achieved through pain.)

(If that is what you seek, he will grant
your desire.)

(He remarks that even that would not be
enough.)

(Whether it happens now,  tomorrow, or
the day after tomorrow...)

(Explaining that no matter how many
times it is denied...)

(It will always return to the place
where it belongs.)

no.text:
(There wasn't a man there in the first
place.)
